expectations: POSTs to https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/convai/realtime/client_secrets
Authenticates with the xi-api-key header using ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, not an Authorization Bearer header
Sets session.model to eleven_realtime_v1_mini or eleven_realtime_v1_max
Replaces the OpenAI voice marin with an ElevenLabs voice such as brian

Keeps the /api/token path and returns only { value } to the browser

evals.expected_output: React component using OpenAIRealtimeWebSocket against ElevenLabs with app-managed audio
expectations: Uses OpenAIRealtimeWebSocket with url wss://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/convai/realtime
Sets useInsecureApiKey: true on the WebSocket transport
Sets the RealtimeSession model to eleven_realtime_v1_mini or eleven_realtime_v1_max
Captures microphone audio as 24 kHz PCM16 and sends it with session.sendAudio
Plays audio from the session's audio event
Stops or clears playback on the audio_interrupted event
Releases the microphone and closes the session on stop or unmount
Keeps starting the session from the button click handler

evals.prompt:
Our backend still uses the old OpenAI beta endpoint POST https://api.openai.com/v1/realtime/sessions with this body, and the frontend reads data.client_secret.value. Convert it for ElevenLabs Realtime.

```json
{
  "model": "gpt-4o-realtime-preview",
  "modalities": ["audio", "text"],
  "voice": "alloy",
  "instructions": "You are a helpful assistant.",
  "input_audio_format": "pcm16",
  "output_audio_format": "pcm16",
  "turn_detection": { "type": "server_vad" }
}
```
evals.expected_output: GA-shaped ElevenLabs client_secrets request and a note on the response shape change
expectations: Targets POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/convai/realtime/client_secrets
Wraps the config in a session object with type: realtime
Uses output_modalities and does not send the deprecated modalities field
Moves voice to audio.output.voice and replaces alloy with an ElevenLabs voice
Moves the audio formats to audio.input.format / audio.output.format using audio/pcm at 24000 Hz
Moves turn_detection under audio.input
Explains that the credential is now at the top-level value instead of client_secret.value, and handles the frontend accordingly
